name: printer
description:
Print text, files, or canvas pages. Use for printing documents, search results, or saved canvas research.

Examples:
- 'Print this: Hello World' → action: print, text: Hello World
- 'Print my canvas' → action: print_canvas (prints most recent)
- 'Print the text summarizer canvas' → action: print_canvas, canvas_id: text_summarizer
- 'Is the printer ready?' → action: status
- 'Cancel the print job' → action: cancel

Canvas pages are formatted with headers, code blocks, and proper margins for multi-page printing.

file_path.description: Path to file to print (alternative to text)

canvas_id.description: Canvas page ID or search term (for action=print_canvas). Omit for most recent.

job_id.description: Specific job ID to cancel (for action=cancel)
